questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Saudi Arabia?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Religion” part of the Saudi Arabia article.

questions.proof: Other big cities are Riyadh, Jeddah and Dammam.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Saudi Arabia?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Saudi Arabia on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Saudi Arabia article.

questions.proof: Saudi Arabia is bordered by Jordan and Iraq to the north, Kuwait to the northeast, Qatar, Bahrain, and the United Arab Emirates to the east, Oman to the southeast, and Yemen to the south.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Saudi Arabia?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Overview” part of the Saudi Arabia article.

questions.proof: Arabic is the only official language in Saudi Arabia.

questions.prompt: What money is used in Saudi Arabia?

hints.nudge: Money names often come from a country’s own words. The other three are spent in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Economy” part of the Saudi Arabia article.

questions.proof: The currency of Saudi Arabia is referred to as the Saudi Riyal.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “The land area is roughly 2,150,000 square kilometres (830,000 sq mi), so Saudi Arabia is geographically the 5th-largest state in Asia and 2nd-largest state in the Arab world after _____.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “world”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Saudi Arabia article.

questions.proof: The land area is roughly 2,150,000 square kilometres (830,000 sq mi), so Saudi Arabia is geographically the 5th-largest state in Asia and 2nd-largest state in the Arab world after Algeria.
